title: PV Sindhu Advances to Arctic Open Second Round
indian_angle: India's top women's singles player PV Sindhu secured a comfortable win to progress in a Super 500 event.
summary: Sindhu eased past Canada’s Wen Yu Zhang in straight games at the Arctic Open, with Tharun Mannepalli and Rounak Chouhan also making it through qualifying.

title: National Coaching Camp Underway for BWF World Junior Championships
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing India's young talent for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships in Cairo.
summary: A national coaching camp is being held at NCE, Guwahati, to prepare Indian shuttlers for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt.

title: BAI Hosts Advanced Level 1 Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: The course aims to enhance the quality of badminton coaching across India, benefitting future generations of players.
summary: BAI is conducting a Level -1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at National Center of Excellence, Guwahati, and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026.

title: Indian Junior Team Camps for Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: These camps are vital for developing India's promising U17 and U15 players for international competition.
summary: Coaching camps for the Indian team are being held at the National Center of Excellence, Guwahati, in preparation for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026.

title: Regulations Released for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: The release of these regulations sets the framework for one of India's key domestic team badminton competitions.
summary: Badminton Association of India has released the regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026.
